analysis:
## Trade Post-Mortem: USD/JPY SELL — WIN

The most predictive elements were the **multi-timeframe bearish alignment (4/5 MTF bearish, weighted 90%)** combined with the **overbought D1 RSI at 68**, which correctly signaled exhaustion in the uptrend despite the golden-cross structure beneath — momentum divergence from trend structure proved to be the key signal. The **sentiment score of 7/10 was the highest layer score** and aligned with positioning data showing JPY net-shorts near neutral, meaning there was limited fuel for further USD/JPY upside and asymmetric room for JPY recovery. The trade held through the BOJ/PCE news risk window (flagged in the original analysis) and still reached target, suggesting the underlying bearish pressure was structural enough to absorb event volatility. Entry timing near the Tokyo session open was appropriate given JPY pair sensitivity to Asian session flows, though the 5-day hold time suggests the move was gradual rather than driven by a sharp catalyst, meaning earlier entry would not have materially improved the outcome.

---

PATTERN: When MTF bearish alignment ≥80% meets RSI>65 on D1, fade trend structure — sentiment confirms momentum exhaustion.
